TOOLS.name: search_notes
TOOLS.description: Search for notes by keyword or tags. Use this when the user refers to notes without specifying an ID.

keyword.description: The keyword text used in the SELECT statement

tags.description: A list of possible tags for the target note

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

start_date.description: Optional start of date range, inclusive. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: Optional end of date range, inclusive. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

TOOLS.name: fetch_all
TOOLS.description: Fetch all user notes from database

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

order.description: Direction of list order. Controls whether to fetch newest or oldest notes first.

TOOLS.name: add_note
TOOLS.description: Add a new note with a title, body text and category tags.

body.description: The body text of the note

tags.description: A set of tags or categories for the note content

TOOLS.name: update_note
TOOLS.description: Update an existing note. Requires a note_id obtained from search_notes.

TOOLS.name: delete_note
TOOLS.description: Delete a note by its ID. Only call this after confirming with the user.

ids.description: List of note ids to be deleted
